subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------C.ACT.
description: Chart on book p. 180 (EVOL-18). MT-INFO (multi-information) is the subject; C-ACT (composite activism) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), TR (transformation) and INFO-DY. From PROG-CONT: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: POL-P (political policies). From TR: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From SPT-DY: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From INFO-DY: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation) and PER-DY (perception dynamics). From PER-DY: ATTN (attraction). The page text speaks of "the progressional continuance of western culture".
